title: Unit 1: Survival: Verbs with Gerund & Infinitive
objective: Mampu menggunakan verb patterns dengan gerund dan infinitive secara tepat, memahami perbedaan makna pada verb seperti remember, forget, regret, try, dan stop, serta menguasai kosakata untuk mendeskripsikan perasaan tidak nyaman dan gerakan (verbs of movement).

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas penggunaan verb patterns dalam bahasa Inggris, khususnya kata kerja yang diikuti oleh gerund (-ing) atau infinitive (to + verb). Beberapa kata kerja seperti imagine, suggest, enjoy selalu diikuti gerund, sementara decide, hope, promise, manage selalu diikuti infinitive. Kata kerja begin, start, dan continue bisa diikuti keduanya tanpa perubahan makna. Yang menarik, kata kerja seperti remember, forget, regret, try, dan stop memiliki makna berbeda tergantung apakah diikuti gerund atau infinitive.
rules: Verb + gerund: imagine, feel like, suggest, practice, miss, can't stand, enjoy, detest, don't mind → Contoh: I enjoy climbing mountains.
Verb + infinitive: manage, want, decide, refuse, hope, promise, ask, learn, expect, afford, offer, choose → Contoh: They decided to descend the mountain.
Verb + gerund OR infinitive (tanpa perubahan makna): begin, start, continue → Contoh: He started climbing / He started to climb (sama artinya).
Remember + gerund = mengingat pengalaman masa lalu → Contoh: I remember eating a sandwich during a Maths class once.
Remember + infinitive = jangan lupa melakukan sesuatu → Contoh: Remember to take a snack with you wherever you go.
Forget + gerund = tidak lagi memikirkan sesuatu yang sudah dilakukan → Contoh: He'll never forget meeting Sandra for the first time.
Forget + infinitive = tidak berpikir untuk melakukan sesuatu yang seharusnya dilakukan → Contoh: He forgot to meet Sandra.
Regret + gerund = merasa menyesal tentang sesuatu yang sudah dilakukan → Contoh: I regret telling you that you're run out of time.
Regret + infinitive = merasa menyesal harus mengatakan atau melakukan sesuatu sekarang/masa depan → Contoh: I really regret to tell Jim.
Try + gerund = sulit melihat apakah kamu bisa melakukan sesuatu yang sebenarnya tidak mudah → Contoh: Try to relax before the test.
Try + infinitive = melakukan dan melihat apa hasilnya → Contoh: Try looking as if you're with some friends.
Stop + gerund = berhenti melakukan aktivitas → Contoh: She should stop to rest (berhenti untuk beristirahat).
Stop + infinitive = berhenti lalu melakukan aktivitas berbeda → Contoh: She should stop resting (berhenti beristirahat).

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum dengan Remember dan Forget
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering bingung membedakan 'remember/forget + gerund' dan 'remember/forget + infinitive'. Yang perlu diingat: gerund untuk kejadian yang SUDAH terjadi (masa lalu), infinitive untuk yang BELUM/HARUS terjadi (masa depan atau kewajiban).
commonTrap.wrong: Don't forget buying food for my packed lunch tomorrow, Mum.
commonTrap.correct: Don't forget to buy food for my packed lunch tomorrow, Mum.

vocab.meaning: celah atau retakan besar di gletser (es)
vocab.collocation: He crawled out of the crevasse despite his extreme injuries.
After reaching the summit, Joe and Simon decided to go back down via the North Ridge.
When I'm with Mrs Meyer I always feel awkward. It's difficult to find something to talk about with her.
After the earthquake, the people on the island were desperate for help.
Karen ought to be desperate of herself – talking to her mother like that!
Carl must have done something wrong, because he's looking so guilty.

dialogue.context: Empat teman (Emma, Liam, Nicole, dan Justin) sedang mengobrol di kafe. Justin terlalu sering menggunakan ponselnya saat berkumpul, dan Nicole merasa diabaikan. Justin kemudian menantang teman-temannya untuk tidak menggunakan ponsel selama akhir pekan.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: It's been such a busy week.

lines.speaker: Liam
lines.text: Too right. So many things to do.
lines.translation: Benar sekali. Banyak hal yang harus dilakukan.

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.text: Same here. And all of these projects for school. It's been fun, though. Hasn't it, Justin?
lines.translation: Sama nih. Dan semua proyek untuk sekolah ini. Tapi menyenangkan, kan, Justin?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Oh, come on, Justin. You're not listening to us at all.
lines.translation: Ah, ayolah, Justin. Kamu sama sekali tidak mendengarkan kami.

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.text: You're always on your phone doing something or other.
lines.translation: Kamu selalu sibuk dengan ponselmu melakukan sesuatu.

lines.speaker: Justin
lines.text: Sorry. I know it's a bad habit, but whenever someone texts me I've just got to reply right away.
lines.translation: Maaf. Aku tahu ini kebiasaan buruk, tapi setiap kali ada yang mengirim pesan, aku harus langsung membalas.

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.text: Seems like we're not important to you any more. You're constantly on the phone. Oh, sorry.
lines.translation: Sepertinya kami tidak penting lagi bagimu. Kamu terus-menerus bermain ponsel. Oh, maaf.

lines.speaker: Justin
lines.text: Ha! True! Hey, I challenge us all not to use our phones for the whole weekend. Not once. I bet you can't.
lines.translation: Ha! Benar! Hei, aku tantang kita semua untuk tidak menggunakan ponsel selama akhir pekan. Sama sekali tidak. Pasti kalian tidak bisa.

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.text: Ridiculous. Of course we can. Why wouldn't we be able to?
lines.translation: Konyol. Tentu saja kami bisa. Kenapa kami tidak bisa?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Really? Oh, come on. Three days without a phone? No problem!
lines.translation: Benarkah? Ah, ayolah. Tiga hari tanpa ponsel? Tidak masalah!

lines.speaker: Justin
lines.text: OK. Let's try it, shall we? You'll never survive the weekend without your phones. You'll see. Anyone who uses their phone has to treat the others to coffee or whatever they want at the café. OK?
lines.translation: OK. Mari kita coba, ya? Kalian tidak akan bertahan akhir pekan tanpa ponsel kalian. Lihat saja. Siapa pun yang menggunakan ponsel harus mentraktir yang lain kopi atau apa pun yang mereka mau di kafe. OK?

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang latihan percakapan dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang pengalamanmu menghadapi situasi survival atau tantangan. Mr. Khoirul akan bertanya pendapatmu tentang berbagai topik survival.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to talk about survival situations. Have you ever been in a challenging situation where you had to keep going even when things were difficult?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I remember climbing a mountain with my friends last year. It was really exhausting.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That sounds tough! What did you do to manage the situation? Did you feel like giving up at any point?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Actually, I wanted to stop several times, but my friends encouraged me to continue climbing. We managed to reach the summit together.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Well done! Now, imagine you're stuck with a problem and need advice. What would you try doing first?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think I would try talking to someone about it, or maybe I'd stop thinking about it for a while and listen to some music to relax.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent strategy! One last question: is there anything you regret not doing when you were younger, or something you regret doing?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I regret not studying harder when I was in junior high school. But I don't regret spending time with my family instead.

quiz.question: Joe and Simon managed _____ the West Face of Siula Grande despite difficult conditions.
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'manage' selalu diikuti oleh infinitive (to + verb). Pola: manage + to + infinitive.

quiz.question: Simon tried _____ two ropes around Joe to secure him, but the situation became hopeless.
quiz.explanation: 'Tried lowering' berarti Simon melakukan dan melihat hasilnya (try + gerund = do it and see the results). Ini berbeda dengan 'tried to lower' yang berarti mencoba dengan susah payah.

quiz.question: I remember _____ a sandwich during a Maths class once. It was really embarrassing.
quiz.explanation: 'Remember + gerund' digunakan untuk mengingat pengalaman masa lalu. Jadi 'remember eating' artinya mengingat saat makan sandwich di kelas Maths.

quiz.question: Don't forget _____ some paper for the printer tomorrow!
quiz.explanation: 'Forget + infinitive' digunakan untuk jangan lupa melakukan sesuatu di masa depan. 'Don't forget to get' = jangan lupa untuk membeli.

quiz.question: When I'm with Mrs Meyer I always feel _____. It's difficult to find something to talk about with her.
quiz.explanation: 'Awkward' artinya canggung atau tidak nyaman dalam situasi sosial. Ini paling sesuai dengan konteks sulit menemukan topik pembicaraan.

quiz.question: After the earthquake, the people on the island were _____ for help.
quiz.explanation: 'Desperate' berarti sangat membutuhkan atau putus asa. Frasa 'desperate for help' adalah collocation yang tepat untuk situasi darurat.
